ch0021_40_green/0101_0701_02_10: Perfect timing! You’re with me today!
ch0021_40_green/7101_0701_01_10:
If you wanna be a top-level Trainer, you
gotta do more than train to win battles.
ch0021_40_green/7101_0701_02_10:
You also gotta make sure your clothes and
manners are classy and dignified.
ch0021_40_green/7101_0701_03_10: You can look to me as your example!
ch0021_40_green/7102_0701_01_10:
I’ve traveled around all sorts of regions,
starting with Kanto.
ch0021_40_green/7102_0701_02_10:
But Pasio’s where the best of the best gather
from around the world.
ch0021_40_green/7102_0701_03_10: Do you know what that means?
ch0021_40_green/7102_0701_04_10:
It means if you reach the top here, you’re
the real deal—better than anyone else!
ch0021_40_green/7103_0701_01_10:
If you want people to think you’re strong,
you gotta make it look effortless.
ch0021_40_green/7103_0701_02_10:
Grown-ups don’t rush into things. They act
with class.
ch0021_40_green/7103_0701_03_10: Just watch me at a party, and you’ll see!
ch0021_40_green/7104_0701_01_10:
If you want to make today special, here’s a
bit of advice.
ch0021_40_green/7104_0701_02_10:
Don’t go into it hoping it’ll be good.
Get out there and MAKE it good!
ch0021_40_green/7104_0701_03_10:
Whether a day becomes a special memory
all depends on you!
ch0021_40_green/7105_0701_01_10:
I think here on Pasio, I’ve been mentoring
you the most, [Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0021_40_green/7105_0701_02_10:
All the time I’ve spent with you so far has
made some pretty good memories!
ch0021_40_green/1701_0701_01_10: Yo! Here—so you remember this lucky day!
ch0021_40_green/1701_0702_01_10:
Good things are in store for you when you
see me. Remember that!
ch0021_40_green/2501_0701_01_10:
I once was invited to a boat party on the
S.S. Anne back in Kanto.
ch0021_40_green/2501_0701_02_10:
It was just as fancy as the parties we have
here on Pasio!
ch0021_40_green/2501_0701_03_10: I’ve got loads of stories to boast about!
ch0021_40_green/2501_0702_01_10:
Come to think of it, I was sent a formal
invitation to that boat party...
ch0021_40_green/2501_0702_02_10:
But Red mentioned he got onboard because
Bill gave him his ticket.
ch0021_40_green/2501_0702_03_10:
Hahaha! That’s the difference between Red
and yours truly!
ch0021_40_green/2511_0701_01_10:
What do you want to do with your
Pokémon? Have fun? Get stronger?
ch0021_40_green/2511_0701_02_10:
Both are important, but if you’re a Trainer,
it ain’t great to lean too far one way or
another.
ch0021_40_green/2511_0701_03_10:
I guess Red’s always valued both since we
started our journeys.
ch0021_40_green/2511_0702_01_10:
You’re just like Red. You’ve got what’s
important as a Trainer.
ch0021_40_green/2511_0702_02_10:
That means you know what real strength is.
Don’t ever lose that, OK?
ch0021_40_green/3001_0701_01_10:
When you’re the best of the best, you can’t
ease up, even in the morning. Look sharp!
ch0021_40_green/3003_0701_01_10:
Eaten yet? If not, I could take you to a
fancy lunch!
ch0021_40_green/3005_0701_01_10:
Night parties are fun! Wanna go to one?
I could take you!
